fusions.name: Mildew Swing
fusions.desc: A swing that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you; each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Puffball Hatchet
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage with a 60% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fruiting Haft
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. For 10 of those seconds a cloud of spores fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Good Mulch
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
